app.controlledScope: QuickJS controlled sink · serial execution · no live authority
app.menuDescription: Settings and logs are shared across workspaces. Opening them performs no native operation.
app.workspaceLimit: {limit} workspaces are open. Close one before creating or reopening another; closed workspaces stay saved.
app.workspaceSummary: One operation at a time. Workspaces are saved named sessions, not attached games.
app.closeConfirm: Workspace “{name}” has an unsaved draft. Closing discards it; the workspace, its saved profiles and file logs are kept.
app.connectionFailed: Controller connection failed · last known state retained
app.workspaceLogHelp: Events the host attributed to this workspace, including run events and dismissed notifications.
app.appLogHelp: Application-scoped events carry no workspace; the wider scope shows every retained event with its attributed origin.
app.closedHelp: This session is no longer open. The saved workspace was kept; its events were not transferred to another session.
app.closedEvicted: Its retained detail was evicted from the bounded closed-workspace list.
app.closedLogHelp: Events attributed to this closed session that remain in the shared bounded buffer.
app.firstWorkspace: Create a named workspace or reopen a saved one. Saved open workspaces return at launch with fresh sessions; drafts, results and runs do not.
app.chooseHelp: Choose a workspace from the dropdown above, create a new one, or reopen a saved one.
app.replayDescriptor: Replay needs a recorded corpus descriptor path.
app.replayEnvironment: Replay needs a saved OCR environment.
app.descriptorLimit: The descriptor path exceeds {limit} bytes and cannot be retained by the host.
app.profileBinding: This saved profile belongs to a different package or schema. Reinspect; it cannot be rebound.
app.numericFields: Correct the numeric fields before saving, validating, or starting.
app.unboundWorkspace: This workspace has no inspected package. Inspect a local package directory before package commands.
app.environmentChanged: Saved settings no longer match this environment. Save changes, then Check again.
app.validated: Draft validated by the backend. Start will validate again.
app.earlierValidated: An earlier draft was validated. Current edits still need validation.
app.profileRenamed: Renamed saved profile to “{name}”. Draft values are unchanged.
app.profileDeleted: Saved profile deleted. Its values remain in this unsaved draft; active runs are unchanged.
app.profilesImported: Legacy import · {imported} imported, {unchanged} already present. Source files were kept.
app.profilesImportPartial: Legacy import stopped · {imported} imported, {unchanged} already present. Committed entries stay; retry skips identical ones and refuses conflicts.
app.reinspected: Package reinspected. The draft was reset to schema defaults; Start will revalidate its identity.
app.bound: Package inspected and bound to this workspace. Start will revalidate its identity and capture current values.
app.created: Workspace saved. It has no package yet; inspect a local package directory when you are ready.
app.reopened: Workspace reopened with a fresh session. Saved names and package settings were kept; no draft or run was restored.
app.deletedElsewhere: Saved profile “{name}” was deleted outside this workspace. Its values remain in this unsaved draft.
app.updatedElsewhere: Saved profile “{name}” was updated outside this workspace. This draft keeps its own values: Update profile overwrites the saved ones; to load them instead, pick “Unsaved draft” and then the profile.
app.renamedElsewhere: Saved profile was renamed to “{name}” outside this workspace. Draft values are unchanged.
app.stopRequested: Stop requested. Waiting for independent cleanup and terminal evidence.
app.settingsSaved: Saved · OCR profile {profile}. Nothing was initialized; active operations keep their captured settings.
app.settingsSavedEmpty: Saved · no OCR environment. Active operations keep their captured settings.
app.waitForCommand: Wait for “{command}” to settle before closing this workspace.
app.ownerCannotClose: This workspace owns the active operation. Stop it and wait for the terminal outcome before closing.

validation.finiteNumber: Enter a finite number; an empty field is not zero.
validation.negativeZero: Negative zero cannot round-trip through desktop JSON without losing its sign.
validation.safeInteger: Enter an exact integer within the JavaScript safe integer range.
validation.exactNumber: This integer cannot be represented exactly by the numeric editor.
validation.unsupportedProfile: This saved profile is not supported by this desktop build.
validation.runtimePath: Enter the OCR runtime library path.
validation.libraries: Enter 1–64 reviewed native library paths, one per line.
validation.logLimit: GUI log limit must be an integer from 1 to 10000.
validation.visibleCount: Choose one or two visible cards.
validation.success: Success visibility must be on or off.
validation.draftChanged: the environment draft has unsaved edits
validation.descriptorChanged: a different corpus descriptor is selected
validation.workspaceChanged: a different workspace or selection revision is current
